card.name: Partway through drug and medical names
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of a long drug name or medical term, such as the r in Refractory, the umar in dimethyl fumarate, or the IN in a brand name. It fires before the rest of the word is spelled out.

modes.label: Generic drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of generic drug names split into parts.

modes.label: Brand names in capitals
modes.description: Middle pieces of capitalized brand names.

modes.label: Medical terms
modes.description: Middle pieces of long clinical words like thrombosis or refractory.
modes.example: peripheral vein throm<<b>>osis and superficial vein thrombosis.

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish the word with the next piece of the name instead of starting a new word.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long drug or disease name, before the name is finished.
